title: Audit log
description: Forensic trail of admin-relevant changes (RBAC denials, RabbitMQ destructive operations, member changes, settings updates). Retention: {{retentionDays}} days. Enterprise plan only.

empty.filtered: No audit events match the filters.
empty.none: No audit events recorded yet. Admin-relevant changes will appear here.
empty.quietDetail: No privileged operations recorded. Admin-relevant changes will appear here as they happen.
empty.title: No recorded actions
empty.body: No actions match these filters yet.
empty.denials: No authorization denials in this range — nothing was blocked.

error.title: Could not load audit log
error.message: The server returned an error. Try again or refine the filters.

export.truncated: Result was truncated to the row cap. Refine filters to capture older history.

forbidden.subtitle: A filterable trail of who changed what, when.
forbidden.title: You don't have access to the audit log
forbidden.body: Viewing the audit log needs the audit:read permission. Ask an organization admin or owner to grant your role access.

subtitle: Who did what, when. Also a diagnosis signal — Qarote reads recent config changes from here.

gate.subtitle: A persistent, filterable trail of operator actions.
gate.title: Audit log is an Enterprise feature
gate.body: Keep a searchable 90-day record of who changed what — and feed recent config changes into Qarote's incident diagnosis.
gate.footnote: Operational logs still run server-side; Enterprise adds persistence, search, export, and the diagnosis signal.
